name: open-artifact
description: Make slide decks, design canvases, whiteboards, spreadsheets, data dashboards, docs, animated films, design systems and free HTML pages as folders of files that open in one local page where the person views, edits, comments and exports; comments sent from the page come back to the agent. Runs locally on Node.js 22 or later.

interface.shortDescription: Decks, designs, boards, sheets, dashboards, docs and animations you comment on
interface.longDescription: Make slide decks, design canvases, whiteboards, spreadsheets, data dashboards, docs, animated films, design systems and free HTML pages as folders of files that open in one local page where the person views, edits, comments and exports; comments sent from the page come back to the agent. Runs locally on Node.js 22 or later.
defaultPrompt: /open-artifact slides a 6-slide pitch for this project
/open-artifact data a dashboard of this CSV
/open-artifact motion a 20-second launch animation for this project
